Photo 1 shows the same drum from a slightly different angle, with the same label and warning symbols.
The drum has two white caps on the lid, one near the top and one near the bottom.
The drum shows some surface wear, minor scratches, and dirt, especially near the bottom.
The label includes hazard symbols: a triangle with an exclamation mark and a diamond with 'CORROSIVE' text.
The label also states 'FOR INDUSTRIAL USE ONLY' and 'UN 1825' at the bottom.
The drum appears to be 200 litres based on the seller's claim and standard drum size, but no capacity marking is visible in the photos.
The drum is outdoors on a concrete surface.
